name: read-only-proof-lacks-a-negative-control
body: The read-only coexistence assertion pins that verify succeeds while another read-only handle is held, but it does not independently demonstrate that a read-write open would fail (lbug's handle classes may not conflict on this fixture), so the exclusive-class claim rests on the production code using `open_read_only`; add a negative control if a read-write conflict becomes observable.
